sampling_model.design: Conditional on each fixed covariate stratum, \(Z\) is randomized with known \(\pi_z(x)=P(Z=z\mid X=x)\) and \(\min_{x,z}\{P(X=x),\pi_z(x)\}\ge\pi_*\); the observed count vector satisfies \(N_n\sim\operatorname{Multinomial}\{n,p_n(u)\}\).
sampling_model.units: The categorical support \(\mathcal J\), rational wage grid \(\mathcal Y\), rational quantile grid \(\mathcal T\), and assertion list \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\) are fixed while \(n\to\infty\).
sampling_model.treatment: The instrument \(Z\), received treatment \(D\), and selection indicator \(S\) are binary; wages are observed only when \(S=1\).
sampling_model.overlap: Positive multinomial cells, randomized-instrument support, and target-mass positivity remain distinct conditions. Causal tangent legality additionally requires \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\); both are certified from rational response-type face data.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The lawful finite-sample domain is \(\mathcal U_n=\{u:p_n(u)\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\}\), not the preimage of the ambient simplex alone. If the selected local family obeys the affine equalities of \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), then relative interior, base convergence, and the compact-uniform centered expansion prove that every fixed compact lies in \(\mathcal U_n\) eventually. Zero-offset minimax convergence still requires \(c_n\to0\); a causal moving offset lies in \(\mathcal K_0=A_\Psi\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 3.4 proves that recession cones form a rational fan under connectedness and the Minkowski--Weyl condition.
Theorems 3.32 and 4.8 construct a compatible compactified polyhedral complex and compute its Hasse diagram combinatorially.
Corollary 4 gives an explicit smoothing, truncation, and discretization error for Gaussian integration over a polytope.
Theorem 2.1 constructs a near-optimal affine detector for two compact convex composite hypotheses through a convex-concave saddle point.
Theorems 1--3 prove convergence of finite-prior Monte Carlo approximations to compact-parameter minimax expected-size confidence regions.
Theorem 1.3 gives a randomized \(O^*(n^3)\) relative-error algorithm for Gaussian volume of a convex set containing the unit ball in the membership-oracle model.
The paper gives convergence conditions for adaptive discretization of finite-dimensional semi-infinite programs with unbounded variables.
Theorem 1 bounds the Le Cam distance between a multinomial experiment and a matching Gaussian experiment when cell-probability ratios are bounded.
Theorem 3.1 establishes uniform coverage for calibrated projection under drifting moment inequalities, and Theorem 3.2 gives an optimization convergence rate on a compact rectangle.
The paper derives sharp marginal quantile-treatment-effect bounds under truncation by death.
Propositions 1--2 derive nonparametric bounds for average wage effects among always-employed compliers in Job Corps.

Under the complier-conditional weak-selection condition in Assumption 3.2, Proposition 3.1 gives sharp mean SLATE bounds for always-selected compliers, and Theorem 4.1 gives inference and joint asymptotic normality.

Theorem 1 proves minimum average Lebesgue volume for the inverted minimal-cardinality multinomial covering collections of Definition 1, and Proposition 1 selects a maximum-coverage tie-break among those minimizers.

Section 5 and Proposition 1 present sharp quantile-treatment-effect bounds for the always-employed stratum under random assignment and individual-level employment monotonicity, and Section 6.4 evaluates those bounds at multiple Job Corps wage quantiles.

body.tldr: The causal tangent base is now corrected by the rational compatible observed-law polytope \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\{q:\mathcal F(q)\ne\varnothing\}\). A proved polyhedral lifting lemma shows that \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\) imply a compatible full-law lift along every tangent direction; no ambient-simplex neighborhood is assumed. The same-law endpoint and outer-rectangle conclusions remain intact. Effective recession compatibility, total CertGluePFL recurrences, quantitative multinomial--Gaussian comparison, and the globally honest expanding-domain primal remain open, so two-sided sampled-data minimax convergence is not yet claimed proved.

project_justification.gap: Existing compact decision theory and multinomial--Gaussian comparison neither supply simultaneous rule approximation on an unbounded recession-incidence diagram nor control separated means escaping every compact. A separate causal-domain defect also arises when multinomial interiority is mistaken for relative interior of the compatible observed-law polytope.
project_justification.niche: Finite-label partial-identification assertions create discontinuous loss and coverage constraints at intersecting faces, while least-favorable means and dual mass can escape along several incident cones. This structure is neither a compact convex hypothesis test nor a routine finite-dimensional semi-infinite program.
project_justification.fill: The proved layer now includes primal attainment and atomic duality, Gaussian smoothing, one-chart averaging, weighted path accounting, exact full-set repair, an exact rational response-type projection for the compatible observed-law polytope, and a computable relative-interior tangent lift. The remaining program is to construct the effective compatible recession library, a total stopping recurrence, a quantitative experiment comparison, and one globally honest expanding-domain transfer rule.

body.related_work: Finite response-type enumeration and rational polyhedral projection supply the corrected compatible-law domain, while the tangent lifting step is a direct relative-interior argument proved here. Carter's positive-cell comparison remains relevant only after this domain issue is separated from experiment comparison; the needed quantitative theorem has not yet been materialized at theorem granularity. Compact Gaussian decision results do not address simultaneous recession compatibility, and drifting-boundary results do not construct the required globally honest finite-label transfer.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The new polytope and lifting lemmas repair the zero-offset causal tangent legality condition but do not prove effective simultaneous incidence density. CertGluePFL still lacks total recursive stopping bounds, and the multinomial transfer still lacks a quantitative comparison theorem. Compact lawfulness and \(c_n\to0\) identify \(\mathfrak G_0\) only on fixed compacts; no argument controls separated means escaping every compact, so the reverse minimax inequality and two-sided convergence remain open. The milliscale four-label certificate also remains open.
body.honest_scope: The causal estimand remains the same-law joint identified set, which is contained in, but need not equal, the product of coordinatewise sharp endpoint intervals. The relative-interior and tangent-image conditions are model-domain restrictions, not conclusions from multinomial cell positivity. The tangent lift is proved conditionally on those transparent restrictions. Effective density and termination remain unproved, moving-offset transfer remains compact-only, and the compact-exhaustion statement retains both minimax inequalities with the globally honest expanding-domain primal recorded as the missing construction.
